# Simulator.Company AI Plugin

> Official Claude Code plugin for Simulator.Company platform. Provides skills and MCP tools for managing actors, graph-based business processes, form templates, financial accounts, and visualisations directly from the IDE.

## Skills

- [simulator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator/SKILL.md): Simulator.Company basics: entity model (actors, forms, layers, accounts), MCP tools, workspace context
- [simulator-access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-access/SKILL.md): Access to Simulator actors, forms, accounts, layers: share, grant, revoke, who has access; request access after a 403
- [simulator-actors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-actors/SKILL.md): Simulator actors (records of a form): create, update, read, search, filter; the data field format; an actor's Corezoid processes and API keys
- [simulator-agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-agents/SKILL.md): Simulator digital twins and agents: find who or what can do a task, delegate it, ask someone's agent
- [simulator-app-generator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-app-generator/SKILL.md): Generate a multi-page web app (Simulator Smart Form plus Corezoid middleware) from existing Corezoid processes
- [simulator-attachments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-attachments/SKILL.md): Simulator files: upload, attach to an actor or comment, list, rename, detach
- [simulator-charts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-charts/SKILL.md): Simulator charts and dashboards on a graph layer: create, reconfigure, read chart data
- [simulator-chat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-chat/SKILL.md): Simulator messages and chats: write to a user, open or reuse a 1:1 or group chat
- [simulator-finance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-finance/SKILL.md): Accounts on Simulator actors: balances, transactions, transfers, currencies, counters, account triggers
- [simulator-forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-forms/SKILL.md): Simulator form templates (Account Templates, «Шаблон рахунків»): create, add fields, status, system forms
- [simulator-graph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-graph/SKILL.md): Simulator graph structure: layers, links, flowcharts, push/pull graph, questions about a graph
- [simulator-init](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-init/SKILL.md): Connect to Simulator.Company: login (OAuth or API key), environment, workspace
- [simulator-meetings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-meetings/SKILL.md): Simulator meetings and video/SIP rooms: schedule, recurring, agenda, join link; call transcriptions
- [simulator-reactions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-reactions/SKILL.md): Comments and reactions on a Simulator actor: comment, reply, read the thread, pin, mark read, stats
- [simulator-simulate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-simulate/SKILL.md): What-if simulation on a Simulator graph layer: model behaviour, change parameters, forecast and compare scenarios
- [simulator-skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-skills/SKILL.md): Simulator workspace playbooks (Skills form): find and run a saved skill, or save a procedure as a new one
- [simulator-smart-forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-smart-forms/SKILL.md): Simulator Smart Form (CDU) pages: create, edit, deploy; viewModel, locale, widgets, releases, rollback
- [simulator-smart-forms-logic](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-smart-forms-logic/SKILL.md): Corezoid backend of a Simulator Smart Form: page init, submit handlers, viewModel; briefs corezoid-create/edit
- [simulator-smart-forms-runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-smart-forms-runtime/SKILL.md): Run an existing Simulator Smart Form for the user: fill it in, submit, walk a wizard, create a smart contract
- [simulator-styles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-styles/SKILL.md): Less/CSS styling of a Simulator Smart Form: themes, layout, component look, design systems
- [simulator-tasks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/corezoid/simulator-ai-plugin/main/plugins/simulator/skills/simulator-tasks/SKILL.md): Simulator tasks and orders for people: create, assign to someone, add approvers or signers, mark done

## MCP Tools

The plugin bundles a Go MCP server that wraps the Simulator REST API:

- **login**: Authenticate with Simulator.Company via OAuth2 browser flow
- **set-workspace**: Save workspace ID to .env for subsequent API calls
- **pullGraphFile**: Export a layer to a local YAML file for editing
- **pushGraphFile**: Sync a local YAML graph file back to a Simulator layer
- **simulationRun**: Simulate a layer: behaviour rules in model time, compare scenarios (read-only)
- **simulationCheck**: Check a behaviour model against a layer before running it (read-only)
- **simulationSnapshot**: Save a layer with account values to <layerId>.sim.yaml for offline simulation
- **createActor**: Create a single actor (node) in a layer
- **createActors**: Bulk-create up to 50 actors in a single call
- **updateActor**: Update actor properties (title, description, status)
- **deleteActor**: Delete an actor from a layer
- **getActor**: Get actor details by ID
- **searchActors**: Search actors by title or custom fields
- **createLink**: Create a link (edge) between two actors
- **massLink**: Create multiple links in one call
- **deleteLink**: Delete a link between actors
- **manageLayer**: Create, update, or delete a layer
- **moveElements**: Move actors on a layer canvas
- **compactGraphLayout**: Auto-layout actors with domain-clustering strategy
- **pruneLongEdges**: Delete links that exceed a Manhattan distance threshold
- **getAllLayerPlacements**: Enumerate all actors on a layer in one call
- **createForm**: Create a new form template
- **updateForm**: Update an existing form template
- **getForms**: List all available form templates
- **createAccountName**: Define an account name (asset, liability, expense, income)
- **createCurrency**: Create a currency for financial tracking
- **addFormAccount**: Add an account to a form template
- **uploadActorPicture**: Set an actor's avatar from URL, local file, or base64 (auto SVG→PNG)
- **uploadActorPictureBulk**: Bulk-upload actor pictures with SHA-256 deduplication
- **createChart**: Create a chart/dashboard actor on a layer
- **updateChart**: Reconfigure an existing chart in place (type, range, sort, filter, series, placement)
- **findSkill**: Discover saved skill playbooks (Skills-form actors) by intent
- **getSkill**: Load a saved skill playbook in full by slug (ref) or id
